class.name: PS3Pad
class.brief_description: PS3 controller helper for pressure and rumble.
class.description: Provides direct access to PSL1GHT pad features on PlayStation 3 builds.

method.name: get_pressure
method.description: Returns button pressure for the given pad button index.

method.name: set_rumble
method.description: Sets weak and strong motor rumble intensities from 0.0 to 1.0.
